Grade: Grade 9

Topic 2.6: Skimming for information

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Skimming for information
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

2. appreciate the different reading skills in language learning
